items.definition:
the action of reciting something from memory
Her recitation of the poem was flawless.

the act of getting rid of something unwanted
Good riddance to bad rubbish.

a small bag, often with a shoulder strap
He carried his books in a leather satchel.

an act of ignoring or treating with disdain
She felt hurt by his public snub.

a type of stretchy fabric
The swimsuit was made of spandex.

a fine plaster used for coating walls
The exterior of the house was covered in stucco.

a person or company that undertakes a part of a larger contract
The main contractor hired a subcontractor for the electrical work.

shin bone
He fractured his tibia during the soccer match.

foaming water in a river or rapids
They went whitewater rafting on their vacation.

a person who is extremely good at something
He's a whiz at math.

a pilot who flies behind and to the side of the lead aircraft; a friend who helps another person with romantic pursuits
He asked his best friend to be his wingman at the party.

an item of additional material added at the end of a book or other publication
Please refer to the addendum for the updated figures.

a highway encircling a city
Traffic on the beltway was heavy during rush hour.

a person who develops their muscles
The bodybuilder lifted heavy weights.

a scientist who studies plants
The botanist identified the rare flower.

a prehistoric human living in caves
The exhibit showed how a caveman might have lived.

a woman who presides over a meeting or committee
The chairwoman opened the discussion.

a person who hears confessions
She sought guidance from her confessor.

an action taken to counteract a danger or threat
The government implemented new countermeasures against cyber attacks.

the state of being drunk
Public drunkenness is illegal in many places.

the state of being a father
He embraced the joys and challenges of fatherhood.

an action, such as a prolonged speech, that obstructs progress in a legislative assembly
The senator threatened to use a filibuster to block the bill.

a male goose; a quick look
He took a quick gander at the newspaper headlines.

the main stand for spectators at a racecourse or sports ground
We had excellent seats in the grandstand for the final race.

a person involved in the ownership and management of industrial enterprises
The wealthy industrialist donated a large sum to charity.

the state of not achieving maximum productivity
The company suffered from widespread inefficiency in its operations.

a movement of people, money, or things into a place
The country experienced a significant inflow of foreign investment.

The rank, status, or dignity of a knight.
He was granted a knighthood for his services to charity.

The skill or practice of saving lives, especially from drowning.
He took a course in lifesaving techniques.

A tropical tree or shrub with roots that grow in salty water.
Mangrove forests are vital ecosystems for coastal protection.

A large, armored robot, typically controlled by a pilot.
The anime series featured giant mecha battling alien invaders.

A word or phrase that describes or limits the meaning of another word or phrase.
In the phrase 'very happy', 'very' is a modifier of 'happy'.

The process by which a foreign citizen becomes a citizen of a new country.
She completed the naturalization process to become a citizen.

A Hawaiian goose, the state bird of Hawaii.
The nene is an endangered species native to Hawaii.

A large fish-eating bird of prey.
We watched an osprey dive into the lake to catch a fish.

An animal's skin with fur or wool.
The hunter carefully removed the deer's pelt.

A long, tapering flag.
The championship pennant flew proudly from the flagpole.

A person who strives for perfection.
As a perfectionist, she spent hours refining every detail of her project.

A soft, malleable material used for sealing.
He used putty to fill the cracks in the window frame.

The act of assigning to a different place or task.
Her reassignment to a new department was unexpected.

A person or thing that repeats.
The device acts as a signal repeater, extending the Wi-Fi range.

A sharp, witty, or angry reply.
Her quick retort left him speechless.

A hereditary commander-in-chief in feudal Japan.
The shogun held real power in feudal Japan, not the emperor.

A public expression of thanks or praise.
I want to give a shoutout to my team for all their hard work.

The process or amount of shrinking.
The company reported significant shrinkage due to theft.

a person prominent in fashionable society
The socialite was known for her extravagant parties.

a soft, rustling sound
We heard the swish of her long dress as she walked past.

a person who supports or approves of someone or something
He was accused of being a sympathizer of the rebel cause.

a type of axe used by Native Americans
The warrior carried a tomahawk as his primary weapon.

equipment or accessories; the act of catching animals
The trappings of wealth include luxury cars and designer clothes.

a roofed open-air gallery or porch attached to the exterior of a building
They sat on the veranda, enjoying the evening breeze.

an idea or thing that is thought of or added later
The garden was an afterthought, added only after the house was built.

a powered aircraft that is lighter than air
The old airship slowly floated across the sky.

a person who evaluates or estimates the nature, quality, or ability of someone or something
The tax assessor evaluated the property's value.

informal short for bazooka
He carried a baz, ready for action.

a person who operates a bomb-aiming device or drops bombs from an aircraft
The bombardier released the payload over the target.

the leader of a people or clan
The chieftain led his tribe into battle.

an attack made in response to an enemy's attack
The army launched a swift counterattack against the invaders.

a state of shame or disgrace
He brought dishonor upon his family by his actions.

an extinct flightless bird; an old-fashioned or stupid person
The dodo bird became extinct centuries ago.

the eldest child
Their firstborn son is now in college.

a dress or gown
She wore a beautiful silk frock to the party.

a drinking glass with a foot and a stem
He raised his goblet in a toast.

a person who pretends to be someone else
The police arrested the imposter who had been posing as a doctor.
